about: Baron final only (27 Sep): the picks from gen-baron-final-only.ts, chosen by eye at game size from 4 Magpies, 4 balloons and 2 shark concepts (contact sheets in ./sheets/). Jonas approves the Magpie before Slice 1b (BUILD_PLAN §5.2); the interim swap may ship with this one.

picks.why: faces left (MONSTER_INFO facing: "left"), the biggest silhouette of the four, open-beaked grin, gems held high so her verb (stealing gems) reads at 0.49 scale; the Baron's purple swirl on her chest

the Baron faces left towards the ninja, laughing, waving the sack of gems; patched black-and-crimson balloon with his purple swirl; reads as him at small size (it flies at about 0.35 of the stage height)
concept only (Star Dunes' guardian, the Baron's lieutenant): bursting out of a dune, the Baron's note in its fin, his sash and swirl; not in the game until Star Dunes ships
